name: Command Strip
description: A compact operational metric strip for status, filters, or system state.

accessibility.semantics: Use a semantic list or landmark label when the strip communicates grouped status.
accessibility.keyboard: No keyboard behavior required unless interactive content is slotted.
accessibility.focus: Inherits global focus styles for slotted links or controls.
notes: Color is never the only communication channel.
Keep status text concise and readable when truncated.

responsive.strategy: Four columns on wide containers, two on medium containers, and one column on narrow containers.

examples.name: Default
examples.notes: Use for compact operational facts, not long explanatory copy.
